dialogues.speaker: Cipac
dialogues.text: Not bad, but not the best.

dialogues.speaker: Cipac
dialogues.text: After all, there's no matches on right this moment. Of course, we're busiest during the Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame, when everyone rushes over to the Stadium with a snack or drink in hand.

dialogues.speaker: Cipac
dialogues.text: And if you get hungry while you're watching a match, go find that young man Agemo.

dialogues.speaker: Cipac
dialogues.text: He's from the Scions of the Canopy, about... This tall. Agh, speaking of which, where's he gotten off to now?

dialogues.speaker: Cipac
dialogues.text: Anyway, he's quick on his feet, that one. Whatever you want, he'll bring you it exactly how it's meant to taste, be it piping hot or ice cold!
